source: US DOT Bureau of Transportation Statistics, Reporting Carrier On-Time Performance (1987-present), TranStats PREZIP monthly files
definition: On time: arrived less than 15 minutes after the scheduled arrival (ArrDel15 = 0). Every scheduled flight is counted; cancelled and diverted flights count as not on time (DOT Air Travel Consumer Report). The industry figure counts every reporting carrier's flights; a carrier figure needs flights in every month of the period.
